Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id CHEMBL3705858, then activities on assay_id, then molecule_dictionary on molregno, then compound_structures on molregno. Filter for exact measurements: standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null and standard_relation is not null. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
